description: Out-of-dataset stress set for the Phase 1 detector: 5 ambiguous prompts with deliberately planted ambiguity (fresh authoring pass, NOT from the Phase 0 dataset) + 5 well-specified prompts that should come back clean. Measures generalization and exposes rule lexicon gaps.

prompts.text: make me an online store for my sneakers, with cart and checkout and stuff

Build a static restaurant website with Next.js and Tailwind. Pages: home, menu (dishes {name, price, description} from a JSON file), contact with address and hours. Deploy target: Vercel. Done = all three pages render and the menu loads from the JSON file.
a social network for dog owners, like instagram but for dogs, make it pop

Write a Python 3 CLI tool using argparse that scans a folder of CSV files and renames columns according to a mapping file (JSON: {old: new}). Prints a summary of changes. Local single-user script, no auth. Done = renaming a 3-file sample folder produces the expected headers.
I need a gym management system, memberships, trainer schedules, and payment handling, make it robust

Build a REST API with FastAPI and PostgreSQL for a book library. Endpoints: POST /books {title, author, isbn}, GET /books?genre=, GET /books/{id}. Include pytest tests for the create and list endpoints. Done = the test suite passes against a seeded database.
an app for tracking my water intake, cute design, with reminders

Build a Chrome extension (Manifest V3, vanilla JS) that highlights sentences longer than 25 words on any webpage and shows a word count tooltip on hover. Settings persist in chrome.storage.sync as {threshold}. No accounts. Done = hovering a 30-word sentence shows the correct count.
build me a chatgpt wrapper for my documents so I can ask questions about them, with login

Build a browser-based Tetris clone with HTML5 Canvas and vanilla JS, no frameworks. Features: falling pieces, rotation, line clears, scoring {lines, level, speed}. Local high-score list in localStorage. Done = a scripted 20-move playthrough completes with correct scoring.
